answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond that scales with the reputation it claims: a thousand fake agents then cost a thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once and earns it back through good work. Newcomers begin in a probationary haven with small, publicly auditable transactions and graduate only after consistent service, so there is no oasis of free trust for fresh identities. Signed, chained attestations leave a crystal-clear trail, letting the network slash any bond caught vouching for its own clones.
